# reposell-example

A minimal **Vite + React** app for testing the [reposell](https://github.com/EnzoVezzaro/reposell) CLI end-to-end.

This example walks you through the full reposell workflow: initialize a project, build a signed artifact, publish a release, generate a license, and list it for sale.

## Quick start

```bash
# install dependencies
npm install          # or bun install

# start the dev server
npm run dev

# open http://localhost:5173
```

## How it works

The repo ships with a pre-configured `reposell.yml` that sets up:

| Feature | Config |
| --- | --- |
| **Product** | `reposell-example` |
| **Licensing** | RSL-1.0 (one-time) |
| **Sell page** | `sell/` — static storefront with payment link |
| **Listing** | Enabled — discoverable on [listing.reposell.dev](https://listing.reposell.dev) |
| **CI** | GitHub Actions → validates, builds, deploys `/sell` to Pages |

## The reposell workflow

```bash
# 1. Initialize signing keys + reposell.yml (already done in this repo)
reposell init

# 2. Build + sign the artifact
reposell build

# 3. Publish a release to GitHub
reposell release

# 4. Generate a buyer license
reposell license

# 5. Announce to the reposell listing directory
reposell listing
```

The app animates these steps in the browser — watch the terminal-style UI tick through each one.

## Project structure

```
reposell-example/
├── reposell.yml            # reposell protocol config (product, releases, payment)
├── sell/                   # /sell storefront (built by `reposell build`)
│   ├── index.html          # sell page with embedded reposell-data JSON
│   ├── styles.css          # dark theme storefront styles
│   └── scripts.js          # scroll-reveal animation
├── .reposell/
│   ├── storefront.json     # storefront theme + section layout
│   └── ai-policy.json      # AI usage restrictions
├── src/
│   ├── App.tsx             # React app — animates the CLI steps
│   └── main.tsx            # entry point
├── .github/workflows/
│   └── reposell.yml        # CI: validate → build → deploy sell page to Pages
├── index.html              # Vite entry HTML
├── vite.config.ts          # Vite config (React plugin)
└── package.json
```

## Configuration

The key file is **`reposell.yml`**:

```yaml
version: 1
product:
  name: reposell-example
licensing:
  schemes:
    standard:
      name: Standard
      billing: one-time
      template: rsl-1.0
releases:
  mode: manual
  definitions:
    v0.1.0:
      status: published
      offers:
        - scheme: standard
          pricing:
            amount: 29
            currency: USD
          payment:
            provider: stripe
            payment_link: https://buy.stripe.com/test_...
sell:
  enabled: true
listing:
  enabled: true
  contribution:
    amount: 5
    currency: USD
```

### What each section does

- **`licensing`** — declares the license scheme (RSL-1.0 one-time purchase)
- **`releases`** — maps versions to payment links and pricing
- **`sell`** — enables the `/sell` storefront page
- **`listing`** — enables discovery on the reposell listing directory with a $5 USD contribution per sale

## CI / GitHub Actions

The workflow at `.github/workflows/reposell.yml` runs on push to main and on release publish:

1. **Validate** — checks `reposell.yml` is well-formed
2. **Build** — signs the artifact and generates the `/sell` surface
3. **Deploy** — publishes the sell page to GitHub Pages

Requires a `REPOSELL_SIGNING_KEY` secret in your repository settings.
